pages.title: Rupee as a barometer of credibility

facts.text: Rupee under pressure — BoP stress; CAD financing hard due to negative net FDI inflows and volatile FPI
facts.head: Context (2026)

facts.text: Dornbusch Overshooting Model: exchange rate overreacts in short run (sticky prices)
facts.head: Theories

facts.text: Mundell-Fleming / Impossible Trinity: cannot have fixed exchange rate + free capital mobility + independent monetary policy together; India — managed float
facts.head: Theories

facts.text: 2013 Taper Tantrum (US Fed) — rupee fell; RBI tightened short-term rates, oil-dollar swap; govt raised gold import duty
facts.head: Exam angle

facts.text: ⚠ RBI buying foreign currency → expands domestic money supply (sterilisation may follow)
facts.head: Exam angle

facts.text: ⚠ Higher FDI inflows → rupee appreciates (not depreciates)
facts.head: Exam angle

facts.text: Depreciation → imported inflation, higher external debt burden
facts.head: Exam angle

facts.text: Fowler Committee (1898): Gold Exchange Standard — rupee pegged to sterling at 1s 4d (15 rupees = £1) — for Home Charges
facts.head: Exam angle
